source.workingTree: dirty because the pinned CEDIA OMP manifest patch is applied; parent verification found tracked/untracked non-ignored tree 112ad5eee1cc236b5382a691ccf3202b2ced5c1e exactly equal to the pinned revision plus that manifest patch

effectivePrecedence: project capability settings (.omp/config.yml and compatible provider files)
settingsWriteContract.read: Settings.get(path) returns merged effective value or schema default; Settings.loadReadOnly avoids migration and writes
settingsWriteContract.write: Settings.set(path,value) persists global config asynchronously; config CLI flushes; only model role assignment has a dedicated project writer when modelRoleStorage=project
settingsWriteContract.reset: config reset writes the schema default (it does not delete the key)
settingsWriteContract.credentials: credential markers/ui.secret are masked in config list JSON/human output; explicit get can return a value, so CEDIA must keep redaction at its bridge boundary

dynamicSlashSources.reload: static registry; built into TUI/RPC/ACP discovery

dynamicSlashSources.roots: native/user/project capability providers; .omp/commands and provider-compatible command roots

dynamicSlashSources.reload: reload plugins/capabilities and re-emit available command metadata
static bundled command; file command wins on name collision

features.surface: plugin CLI + marketplace slash commands + reload
bash PTY, hub jobs, shell command, RPC bash/abort_bash
git TUI, worktree CLI, commit/review flows
speech-to-text and Thai quality are intentionally deferred

nativeAccountActions.boundary: These are OMP-native provider-account/credit APIs owned by OMP AuthStorage; do not substitute a second Codex/Synara harness or expose unrelated account UI.

bridgeRequirements.rule: CEDIA uses OMP RPC/RPC-UI/ACP transports and negotiates protocol versions; it does not start another agent loop.

Slash specs with handleTui but no handle are TUI-only. CEDIA must expose them through an explicit versioned host/UI bridge or retain a TUI-compatible surface; ACP cannot invoke them as ordinary text commands.
Remote clients must consume available_commands_update after startup, extension initialization, /move, and plugin/MCP/skill reloads; never cache one command list forever.
OMP owns execution, transcript, auth, and provider account state; CEDIA owns presentation/transport only.

caveats: This is a source inventory and bridge contract, not proof that CEDIA has implemented every surface.
Speech-to-text/Thai quality is explicitly deferred by the current user request.
Some settings are feature/config-file-only or runtime-only despite appearing in the schema; UI metadata is the source for TUI exposure.
The inspected tree is the pinned OMP revision plus the verified CEDIA manifest patch; re-run this inventory if that source contract changes.
